描述_EN: the white face preparations, made of rice paste, variously contained lead, aluminium, calcium, silicon, magnesium and silver. white foundation plus rouge seem to have been the basis for face-painting for several centuries. the rouge was made from the flowers of the red indigo plant from gansu province. this cosmetic box with three shallow containers inside is made of glazed stoneware from the longquan kilns of china's zhejiang province. the little containers may have held make-up for the face or hair.
描述_ZN: 白色的脸部制剂，由米糊制成，含有不同的铅、铝、钙、硅、镁和银。 白色粉底加胭脂似乎是几个世纪以来脸部彩绘的基础。 胭脂是由甘肃省的红蓝植物的花制成的。 这个化妆盒里面有三个浅的容器，是由中国浙江省龙泉窑的釉面石器制成的。 这些小容器可能是用来装面部或头发的化妆品的。
